title: Pertamina Eco RunFest 2026 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: Pertamina Eco RunFest Review: Jakarta Course, Humidity, Results
meta_description: Pertamina Eco RunFest review from the 2025 race: a 4.45am start at GBK, 94% humidity, cut-offs, 1,335 half-marathon finishers, winning times after a doping DQ, and entry rules.
dek: What it was like to run Pertamina's Jakarta race in November 2025: the route from Gelora Bung Karno, the humid dawn, the start times and cut-offs, how fast the field ran, and how entry and race packs work.
verdict: Enter if you want a big, well-organised Jakarta race with a World Athletics Label half marathon, a real elite race at the front and plenty of podium categories for Indonesian runners. The 2025 edition drew 14,000 runners by Pertamina's count, with 1,335 finishing the half, which started at 4.45am from GBK. The catch is the air. Halim airport recorded 25°C, a dew point of 24°C and 94% humidity before dawn, and still 84% at 8am, so pace for humidity, not the clock. Foreign runners can enter only the Half Marathon Open, and places are sold only through the MyPertamina app, first come first served and non-refundable. In 2025 all 14,000 went.

sections.heading: The Course: Central Jakarta, an Underpass and a Flyover
paragraphs: The run starts and finishes at Plaza Parkir Timur, the east car park of the Gelora Bung Karno sports complex [1]. Police said the 2025 route used Jalan Sudirman, Senopati, Pattimura and Sisingamangaraja, as far as the Antasari elevated road (JLNT Antasari) [2], and half marathoners passed a checkpoint on Sudirman-Thamrin [3]. Two runners quoted by CNN Indonesia after the race singled out a stretch that drops into an underpass and climbs back out [4].

The race holds a World Athletics Label, which Pertamina said was verified in 2025 [5]. The results show timing points on the half marathon at 4.8, 10, 15.4, 16.9, 18.2, 18.5, 20.2 and 20.7 km [6]. For 2026 the official route page still lists the distance, elevation and GPX file as coming soon [7].
Police warned drivers to expect congestion on those roads from 4am and to follow officers' directions [2].

sections.heading: The Weather: Saturated Air Before Dawn
paragraphs: Halim Perdanakusuma airport, about 11 km south-east of GBK, recorded 25°C at 4.30am and 5am, with a dew point of 24°C, 94% humidity and a 3 to 5-knot wind [8]. It did not change until after 6.30am. By 7.30am it was 27°C with 89% humidity, and at 8am and 8.30am, around the half-marathon cut-off, 27°C with 84% [8].

It was not especially hot, but a dew point of 24°C is near the top of the range runners find oppressive: sweat barely evaporates, so effort rises long before the temperature does. Start slower than your usual pace and drink early.

sections.heading: Start Times, Cut-offs and Aid
paragraphs: The organiser's FAQ gave flag-off times of 4.45am for the half, 5.15am for the 10 km, 5.20am for the 5 km and 5.30am for the family run, with limits of three and a half hours for the half, two hours for the 10 km and one hour for the two short races [9]. A post-race report gave the same times for the three longer races [3]. A pre-race radio report instead said the half would start at 5.15am with a four-hour limit [1].

The results list 44 half marathoners as finishers with gun times over three and a half hours, the slowest in 3:46:31 [6], so the results point to the limit not being applied at 3:30 at the finish in 2025.

A first-time 10 km runner quoted in the same report said the event was neat, the pacers encouraging and the water stations plentiful [4]. Bag storage opened at 4am for runners with a bib, there were no changing rooms, and cutting the course was banned [9].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The half marathon's Open category, the one foreign runners can enter, drew an East African field. The first man across the line, Kenya's Mathew Samperu in 1:04:23, tested positive for testosterone in a sample taken at the race and was banned for three years by the Athletics Integrity Unit, forfeiting the prizes [10]. World Athletics lists the runner as disqualified, making Bahrain's Dawit Fikadu the winner in 1:06:17, ahead of Ethiopia's Teklu Bekele in 1:07:09 [11]. Kenya's Lucy Nthenya won the women's race in 1:15:41, with Indonesia's Nefriana Daik second in 1:21:46 [11].

Behind the professionals the field is ordinary. Tenth place was 1:20:44 for men and 1:39:35 for women [6]. In the categories for Indonesians and Pertamina staff, the fastest man ran 1:12:16 and tenth 1:34:10; the fastest woman ran 1:25:43 and tenth 1:56:08 [6]. The median finisher took 2:38:21, 345 of the 1,335 finishers took more than three hours, and only 219 were women [6]. Pertamina put up 66 podium places across national, junior, company and age categories [1].
The 10 km, closed to foreigners, was won in 31:14 by a man and 38:08 by a woman; tenth places were 38:14 and 47:46 [6][9].

sections.heading: Tickets, Race Packs and the Festival
paragraphs: Places are sold only through the MyPertamina app, one ticket per person per transaction, first come first served, and tickets cannot be cancelled or refunded [9]. In 2025 sales opened on 21 July [12] and all 14,000 places sold out [3]. The half cost Rp600,000, the 10 km Rp450,000, the 5 km Rp300,000 and the family run Rp350,000 for one child and one adult [9].

Foreign runners could enter only the Half Marathon Open, from age 17; the other half-marathon and 10 km categories were for Indonesians or Pertamina employees, and the 5 km was open to the general public from age 13 [9].

Race packs were collected at Wisma Serbaguna GBK on Friday 21 November, 10am to 8pm, and Saturday 22 November, 10am to 6pm. A representative needed a signed power of attorney, and anyone who missed collection was treated as having withdrawn [9].

The run is the morning half of a day-long event with an eco market and an evening music festival that needs a separate ticket [9]. Pertamina says every emission from runners, the stage and the festival was offset through its own carbon-offset programme and that event waste was to be recycled [5], with Waste4Change managing it [3]. These are the company's own claims.

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a large, neatly run Jakarta race with a labelled half marathon, a real elite race at the front and many podium categories for Indonesian runners. The 1.5 km family run and the 5 km suit families and first-timers.
Think twice if you are a foreign runner who wants the 10 km, or if you struggle in humidity: the 2025 half started in 94% humidity.

The 2026 race is on Sunday 6 December at Plaza Parkir Timur and Istora Senayan [13]. The half is scheduled to flag off at 4.50am with an 8.20am cut-off [14], the half-marathon fee rises to Rp700,000, foreign runners are again limited to the Half Marathon Open [13], and race packs are collected at Ratu Plaza on 4 and 5 December [15]. The route, elevation and water stations had not been published when this was written [7].

Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the organiser's FAQ and race pages, the full results, World Athletics records, airport weather records, and Indonesian and Kenyan news reports.

faqs.question: Can foreigners run Pertamina Eco RunFest?
faqs.answer: Only the half marathon. In 2025 foreign runners could enter the Half Marathon Open, from age 17, while the other half-marathon and 10 km categories were for Indonesians or Pertamina staff. The 2026 rules again say foreign nationals can enter only the Half Marathon Open. All places are sold through the MyPertamina app.

faqs.question: How humid is Pertamina Eco RunFest?
faqs.answer: Very. At 4.30am and 5am on race morning in 2025, Halim airport, about 11 km from Gelora Bung Karno, recorded 25°C, a dew point of 24°C and 94% humidity with little wind. It was still 27°C with 84% humidity at 8am, around the half-marathon cut-off. Pace for the humidity, not the temperature.

faqs.question: What time does Pertamina Eco RunFest start?
faqs.answer: Early. In 2025 the organiser's schedule started the half marathon at 4.45am, the 10 km at 5.15am, the 5 km at 5.20am and the family run at 5.30am, from Plaza Parkir Timur at GBK. For 6 December 2026 the half is scheduled to start at 4.50am, with an 8.20am cut-off.

faqs.question: How fast is the Pertamina Eco RunFest half marathon?
faqs.answer: Fast at the very front and ordinary behind. World Athletics lists the 2025 winners in 1:06:17 and 1:15:41, after the first man home was disqualified for doping. Tenth place was 1:20:44 for men and 1:39:35 for women, and the median finisher took 2:38:21. There were 66 podium places across categories.

faqs.question: How do you get a place at Pertamina Eco RunFest?
faqs.answer: Through the MyPertamina app only: one ticket per person, first come first served, and no refunds. In 2025 sales opened on 21 July and all 14,000 places sold out. The half marathon cost Rp600,000 in 2025 and is priced at Rp700,000 for 2026. Race packs must be collected in person or by proxy.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-29 to the review template, about the previous edition (23 November 2025). Weather is from Jakarta Halim airport METAR observations, about 11 km from the start, not a forecast. Full results were loaded from the timer's public results table. The organiser's FAQ and a post-race report give a 4.45am half-marathon start with a 3.5-hour limit; a pre-race RRI report gave 5.15am and four hours, and 44 finishers are listed over 3:30, so both are mentioned. The timer's results still list the first finisher, later banned for doping; World Athletics lists the runner as disqualified, and the review uses the World Athletics order. The runner accounts used appear word for word in several outlets, including advertorials, so they probably come from Pertamina's own release; no independent runner accounts were found, and the 2025 route map was an image no longer online. The carbon-offset figures are Pertamina's claims. No rating.
